_comment: One-shot consult (Downlink report). Fuente unica: docs/research/5-verificacion.md, seccion 'Listo para cargar' (solo VERIFIED / VERIFIED-WITH-EDIT, con su texto final). design_text = texto de DISENO (UX), sin fuente y sin source_ids. earth_reference = referencia terrestre (marina mercante / emergencias): la UI muestra el aviso. La app NO diagnostica ni sugiere tratamiento: preguntar que medicacion se tomo es historia. Excluidos a proposito: diagnostico y diferencial (SCMG 5.0), 'Assessment' de SBAR, alcohol/drogas, historia familiar/social, etnia. answer.type: free_text | choice (options, with_text) | time (with_text) | scale_0_10 (anchors) | auto (fill: timestamp | latest_readings | mission_context; with_text). skip_if: { answered: <question id> } oculta la pregunta si esa otra ya tiene respuesta; { set_active: <set id> } la oculta si el sintoma incluye ese set. placement de help: notice (aviso fijo), top, why (desplegable), module (ayuda de un set via help_id), after (despues de enviar).

help.text: This report collects information only. It does not diagnose or suggest treatment.

help._comment: Primera mitad con fuente (SCMG: completar el formulario antes de pedir ayuda); 'so the ground team gets as much as possible in one message' es (UX).
help.text: Fill this in before you transmit, so the ground team gets as much as possible in one message.
On long missions such as to Mars, consulting doctors on Earth in real time may be impractical.
Checklists and clinical guidance tools can help crews work with long communication delays.
On the ISS, medical data are sent to flight surgeons on the ground for interpretation.
These questions follow OPQRST, a memory aid used to assess acute pain.
SAMPLE is a memory aid that emergency care courses use for taking a short, focused history.

help._comment: SCMG: anotar el consejo y repetirlo. 'in your next message' es adaptacion por retardo (UX).
help.text: Write down the reply and read it back in your next message.

symptoms._comment: Abrir primero el protocolo crew_chest_pain_conscious (UX). No se cita la fila 'Chest pain' de WHO (diagnostico + aspirina).

symptoms.label: Injury

symptoms._comment: Sin OPQRST. No se cita la fila WHO 'Fever or HIV' (diagnostica).

question_sets._comment: Set 1. La S (severidad) es pain_now del set pain_scale.
question_sets.title: About the pain (OPQRST)

questions.text: When did it start, and what were you doing at that moment?
Did it start suddenly or gradually?

questions._comment: Los ejemplos (moving, breathing, resting, position) son (UX).
questions.text: Does anything make it better or worse (for example moving, breathing, resting, position)?
Describe it in your own words. For example: cramping, stabbing, burning, electric shock, pressure.
Where exactly do you feel it? Does it spread or move anywhere else?
Is it constant, or does it come and go? Has it changed since it started?
What symptoms do you have? List all of them, starting with the one that bothers you most.
Do you have any known allergies? If yes, what happens when you react?
List all medicines you were taking before this started: name, dose and how often.

questions._comment: Historia, no recomendacion. Sin cita WHO (su ejemplo es tratamiento).
questions.text: List all medicines taken or given since this started: name, dose and the time of each dose.
Any important past illnesses, injuries or operations?
When did you last eat or drink?

questions._comment: Se omite si ya se respondio o_when (UX).
questions.text: What were you doing just before this started? Describe what happened.

question_sets._comment: Set 4. Anclas de Pathak (CC BY), no las del BPI. pain_words: opciones de Prachanukool; 'None' y la frase de ayuda son (UX).
question_sets.title: Pain scale

questions.text: How strong is it right now, from 0 (no pain) to 10 (maximum pain)?
Some people find words easier than numbers. You can also choose a word.
Did you lose consciousness, even briefly? Do you remember everything that happened?
Any bleeding? About how much?

question_sets._comment: Set 3: datos minimos para el medico remoto (estructura S-B-Observations-Questions, UX sobre SBAR; sin 'Assessment'). Sin foto adjunta en la app (limitacion).
question_sets.title: For the remote physician

questions.text: Date and time (UTC)

questions._comment: La app no guarda edad ni sexo: se pide como texto libre.
questions.text: Age and sex (name optional)
In your own words, what is the main problem?

questions._comment: Se omite si el sintoma incluye OPQRST (UX).
questions.text: When did it begin, how did it begin, and how has it changed since?

questions._comment: Adjuntar las lecturas registradas con hora es (UX). No se muestran los valores normales WHO.
questions.text: Attach your latest readings: temperature, pulse, breathing rate (and blood pressure, oxygen saturation if available).
Describe your general appearance and how the affected area looks (for example swelling, tenderness or reduced movement). Add a photo if you can.
Any tests or measurements already done? What were the results?
What first aid or other care has already been given? How did you respond to it?
What worries you most right now?
What do you most need the ground team to answer?

questions.text: Mission context: location, current round-trip delay and on-board medical kit
